evidence: Request: GET /api/schedule. Observed: sauna-F weekly schedule gives pukuhuone 8 only Tuesday 17:00–18:30 status free, and pukuhuone 9 Thursday, Friday and Saturday 17:00–18:30 status free, with no Tuesday key. Consequence: Tuesday shows a bookable slot for pukuhuone 8 and no slots for pukuhuone 9.

Request: POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 9","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 409 {"ok":false,"reason":"closed_day","message":"Valitettavasti pukuhuone 9 ei ole saunapäivää Tuesdayna. pukuhuone 9 on auki: Thursday, Friday, Saturday. Voit varata seisovan vuoron Tuesday klo 17:00 pukuhuone 8ssa.","openDays":["Thursday","Friday","Saturday"],"alternative":{"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"}} Consequence: the request is refused because pukuhuone 9 has no sauna day on Tuesday, and the refusal names Thursday, Friday and Saturday. The schedule still has no Tuesday slot for pukuhuone 9.

Request: POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"} while that slot was free. Observed: HTTP 200 slot ss-1 apartment 12, Tuesday 17:00–18:30, message "Standing slot confirmed for 17:00 to 18:30 every Tuesday." Re-read: schedule status held holder 12; posted list shows apartment 12 for pukuhuone 8 Tuesday 17:00–18:30. Consequence: the standing slot is confirmed for 17:00 to 18:30 and apartment 12 holds it on the weekly Tuesday.

Request: after apartment 12 held Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8, POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":3,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 409 {"ok":false,"reason":"slot_held","message":"The slot on Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is already held.","holder":12}. Re-read: schedule holder remains 12; posted list still shows only apartment 12 for that slot. Consequence: the second household is refused because the slot is held, and apartment 12 still holds it.

Request: apartment 12, already holding Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 with other slots free, POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 9","weekday":"Thursday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 200 slot ss-2 Thursday 17:00–18:30, message "Standing slot confirmed for 17:00 to 18:30 every Thursday." Re-read: schedule and posted list both show apartment 12 holding Tuesday pukuhuone 8 and Thursday pukuhuone 9. Consequence: the second standing slot is confirmed and persisted.

Request: with apartment 12 holding only Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 and apartments 3, 5 and 7 holding the other three weekly slots, POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 9","weekday":"Friday","startTime":"17:00"}. Observed: HTTP 409 {"ok":false,"reason":"schedule_full","message":"The weekly schedule has no free standing slot. No slot is available to book.","householdSlots":1}. The message does not name a day or time to choose and alternative is absent. Re-read: apartment 12 still holds exactly Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8. Consequence: the second slot is refused because the schedule has no free standing slot, and the original hold remains the only one.

Request: POST /api/standing-slots/request {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"} on a free slot. Observed confirmation HTTP 200 slot ss-1 17:00–18:30. Re-read of the same booking: schedule holder 12 status held end 18:30; posted list shows apartment 12 for that slot; heater schedule heats pukuhuone 8 Tuesday 17:00–18:30; invoicing signal inv-1 type standing_slot_charge names apartment 12 for that slot. Consequence: the posted list, heater schedule and billing signal all match the one confirmed booking.

Request: POST /api/standing-slots/give-up {"apartment":12,"dressingRoom":"pukuhuone 8","weekday":"Tuesday","startTime":"17:00"} after that standing slot was confirmed. Observed: HTTP 200 {"ok":true}. Re-read: posted list {"slots":[]}; heater schedule {"entries":[]}; schedule shows Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 free with holder null. Invoicing signals still contain standing_slot_charge inv-1 for apartment 12, pukuhuone 8, Tuesday 17:00–18:30 and also standing_slot_cancelled inv-2 for apartment 12 at that slot. Consequence: the list and heater no longer claim the slot, but a standing-slot charge for apartment 12 remains, so the billing view disagrees with the other derived views.

Request: both households POST /api/standing-slots/request for Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8, apartment 12 and apartment 3; both request bodies were sent before either response was read (send gap 0.093 ms). Observed: apartment 12 HTTP 200 confirmed slot ss-1 17:00–18:30; apartment 3 HTTP 409 slot_held, message "The slot on Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is already held.", holder 12. Re-read: schedule holder 12; posted list only apartment 12; heater heats that one window; invoicing has one standing_slot_charge for apartment 12. Consequence: exactly one request was confirmed, the other was refused because the slot is held, and no derived view shows two holders.

Request: the same in-flight pair, apartments 12 and 3 both posting Tuesday 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 before either response was read, repeated 100 times. Each run started only after GET /api/schedule showed that slot free; a prior holder was released with POST /api/standing-slots/give-up. Observed counts: one-confirmed 100, both-confirmed 0, neither-confirmed 0. Apartment 12 was the confirmed household on 51 runs and apartment 3 on 49. Every refused response was HTTP 409 reason slot_held. Every run left exactly one posted holder matching the confirmation. Consequence: all 100 runs confirmed exactly one household; none confirmed both; none refused both.
Blind REQUEST: pukuhuone 8 | Tuesday | 17:00 confirmed over HTTP 200 with standing slot confirmation.
